answer: Require every agent to post a 40 POA bond locked 25 epochs before it can earn, with 100% slashed on proven duplication. Each attestation creates a grading duty: for every 10 attestations, it must grade one unrelated peer, never kin — no shared funder, no shared harbor, no matching pattern. A sparrow account grading only its cluster is flagged, its unpaid balance frozen, and a raven audit re-checks the cluster. Bonds, duties, and kin links sit on a public ledger, checkable in seconds. Each fake costs 40 POA locked, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA locked.
